# TokenCacheManager

- Namespace: `PPDS.Auth.Credentials`
- Assembly: `PPDS.Auth`
- Kind: Class

## Summary

Manages token cache operations including clearing cached credentials.

## Members

### Methods

#### ClearAllCachesAsync

`Task ClearAllCachesAsync(string tokenCachePath)`

Clears the MSAL file-based token cache.

- Param `tokenCachePath`: Optional path to the token cache file. If null, uses the default global path.
Pass a custom path when using isolated test directories to avoid clearing production cache.
